doctrine.noGate: Tradewind does not invent stage gates that compress uncertainty into a silent pass. Authorization boundaries and operator decisions are hard. Product theater gates are forbidden. Evidence stays visible until a human resolves or defers it.
doctrine.provenance: Every normalized fact retains source identity and record boundary.
doctrine.actionBoundary: Offers, contracts, assignments, and outreach require an explicit operator decision.

pillars.name: Authorized intake
pillars.description: Only approved channels may create operating records. Open-ended scraping is not the intake model.

pillars.name: Source provenance
pillars.description: Normalized facts keep the source and boundary needed for later review.

pillars.name: Conflict visibility
pillars.description: Competing values stay attached to evidence; the system never silently overwrites.

pillars.name: Typed state honesty
pillars.description: Incomplete intake, ready-for-review, conflict, and follow-up states stay distinct.

pillars.name: Operator control
pillars.description: Automation stops at the action boundary. Humans decide what happens next.

pillars.name: Underwriting honesty
pillars.description: Refuse to invent ARVs, comps, or distress facts. Log blocks instead of guessing.

pillars.name: Legal guardrails
pillars.description: Jurisdiction disclosures and attorney-close constraints are non-negotiable product behavior.

pillars.name: Dollar cost clarity
pillars.description: Every feature carries an explicit dollar ledger entry for build, run, and risk cost.

churnDrivers.name: Silent overwrite
churnDrivers.severity: Operators lose trust when a second source replaces the first without a review queue.

churnDrivers.name: Auto-action past the boundary
churnDrivers.severity: Unattended offers, dials, or assignment blasts create legal and reputation risk.

churnDrivers.name: Opaque composite score
churnDrivers.severity: Compressed scores hide which evidence failed and invite rubber-stamp decisions.

churnDrivers.name: Fabricated underwriting
churnDrivers.severity: Guessed ARVs and fake comps destroy downstream negotiation math.

churnDrivers.name: Non-idempotent re-ingest
churnDrivers.severity: Repeated intake that duplicates outreach or state transitions burns buyers and sellers.

churnDrivers.name: Gate theater
churnDrivers.severity: Fake approval steps that do not inspect evidence waste time and teach operators to ignore controls.

churnDrivers.name: Lost provenance
churnDrivers.severity: Facts without sources cannot be defended in review or dispute.

priorities.title: Provenance + conflict review
priorities.outcome: Every material field is attributable; disagreements enter an operator queue.

priorities.title: Hard action boundary
priorities.outcome: No offer, contract, assignment, or outreach leaves the system without an explicit decision.

priorities.title: Honest underwriting
priorities.outcome: Underwriting refuses insufficient comps and never fabricates values.

priorities.title: Typed pipeline states
priorities.outcome: Illegal transitions are impossible; audit events cover automated and human steps.

priorities.title: Dollar cost ledger
priorities.outcome: Build/run/risk dollars are attached to every shipped feature for permanent review.

scoringDimensions.name: Pillar alignment
scoringDimensions.description: How directly the feature strengthens one or more weighted pillars.

scoringDimensions.name: Churn reduction
scoringDimensions.description: How much the feature removes a named churn driver.

scoringDimensions.name: Priority fit
scoringDimensions.description: Fit to current Priorities 1–5 (higher ranks score higher).

scoringDimensions.name: Operator clarity
scoringDimensions.description: Whether an operator can explain the feature outcome without a hidden model.

scoringDimensions.name: Reversibility
scoringDimensions.description: How safely the feature can be rolled back or deferred without corrupting state.

hardFails.description: Invented comps, ARVs, contacts, or distress facts.
Overwrites a sourced field without preserving the prior value and opening review.
Sends offers, dials, contracts, or assignments without an explicit operator decision.
Weakens or removes jurisdiction-required disclosures or attorney-close routing.
Adds an approval step that does not inspect evidence or authorization.
Normalizes facts while discarding source identity.

rules: Any hard-fail veto blocks ship regardless of score.
Credits may raise score but cannot clear a veto.
Scores below reviewMin stay draft; reviewMin–shipMin-1 need human approval; shipMin+ may ship if no veto.

catalog.description: Emits reviewable audit events for automated and human steps.
Ships with a complete dollar cost ledger stub.
Outcome is explainable in one operator sentence without hidden scores.
